claims.statement: AWS-003 (HIGH) on aws:811596193553/us-east-2 under account i-aa2d3b42e5c6e801a: Cloud service discovery burst. 'i-aa2d3b42e5c6e801a' made 545 read calls across 87 distinct services in 600s, 538 of them refused for want of authority (99%). Breadth with no permission behind it is enumeration rather than administration. The rule counts how many services were read, not which, so it cannot say whether the target was the account's service inventory or its infrastructure.

AWS-004 (HIGH) on aws:811596193553/us-east-2 under account i-aa2d3b42e5c6e801a: Authorization-denial burst. 'i-aa2d3b42e5c6e801a' was refused authorization 538 times in 600s, across 450 distinct resource types. Refusals spread across this many kinds of object are consistent with a caller establishing what its credential can reach. A refusal says what the platform would not do; it does not say what the caller intended.
